name: Intercom
summary: Intercom offers customer engagement and support tools, and its OAuth2 API allows access to user, conversation, and workspace data. Public integrations must use OAuth, while private apps may use Access Tokens. The OAuth process requires app registration, permission selection, and regionalized redirect URIs.
decision: If you are creating a public integration that needs to access other Intercom workspaces, use the OAuth setup described in Intercom's developer documentation. Composio-managed OAuth is available, so you may use either the managed option or bring your own app, depending on your needs.

auth_type.note: Intercom requires OAuth2 for public integrations.

setup_path.label: Use either Composio-managed OAuth or supply your own Intercom app credentials.
setup_path.note: Composio-managed OAuth is explicitly available for Intercom.

prerequisites.title: Intercom Developer Account
prerequisites.body: You must have an Intercom workspace and access to the Developer Hub.

steps.title: Register your app in Intercom Developer Hub
steps.body: Create an app in your Intercom workspace's Developer Hub. Select the OAuth option in the app's Authentication section.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URLs
steps.body: Add one or more HTTPS redirect URLs for your app, which Intercom will POST to after your user authorizes access.
steps.note: These must use HTTPS; multiple URLs are allowed for different environments such as testing and production.

steps.title: Select Access Permissions (OAuth Scopes)
steps.body: Choose only the required scopes your application needs, as unnecessary scopes will prolong approval and may cause rejection. If using Canvas Kit, required scopes will be pre-selected and cannot be unselected.

steps.title: Initiate the OAuth Flow
steps.body: Redirect users to the region-appropriate Intercom OAuth endpoint using your application's client_id and a state parameter. After approval, Intercom redirects the user to your redirect URL with an authorization code.
steps.note: Use the host that matches the user's Intercom workspace region (US, EU, AU) for best experience.

steps.title: Exchange Authorization Code for Access Token
steps.body: Make a POST request to https://api.intercom.io/auth/eagle/token with your client_id, client_secret, the received code, and your redirect URI to receive an access token.

steps.title: Use the Access Token
steps.body: Make authenticated API requests to Intercom by passing the token as an Authorization:Bearer header.

human_actions.title: Register Application
human_actions.body: Sign in to the Intercom Developer Hub and create/register your app.

human_actions.title: Configure Redirect URLs and Permissions
human_actions.body: Manually enter and confirm correct redirect URLs and select required permission scopes.

human_actions.title: Approve Consent Dialog
human_actions.body: Manually initiate and approve the OAuth flow via the browser to grant access.
